enrichment.summary: Student Program for Academic & Athletic Transitioning (SPAAT) of Oakland will run The Athletes Code, a school-based prevention and intervention program combining academic, athletic and enrichment services, for 120 students at Westlake and Montera Middle Schools. The agreement dates, August 13 through December 31, 2020, fall before this vote.

vendor.name: Student Program for Academic & Athletic Transitioning (SPAAT)

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Declares the results of the November 3, 2020 Measure Y school bond election
enrichment.summary: The board adopts Resolution No. 2021-0030, which formally declares the results of the Measure Y school bond election held November 3, 2020. The item text does not state the vote totals or any dollar amount.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Certification of Measure "Y" - District's General Bond Election Results - November 3, 2020

enrichment.headline: Puts Measures B, J and Y bond spending under one citizens' oversight committee
enrichment.summary: The board adopts Resolution No. 2021-0031, which gives one Independent Citizens' School Facilities Bond Oversight Committee the job of monitoring and reporting on spending of facilities bond Measures B, J and Y. The committee is renamed to match, and Board Bylaw 9131 is amended accordingly.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Establishment - District Independent Citizens School Facilities Bond Oversight Committee - As the Oversight Committee for Measure "Y" - Amending Board Bylaw 9131 Accordingly

enrichment.headline: Adds $64,187.07 for Consolidated Engineering Laboratories' testing at the Emerson softball field
enrichment.summary: Consolidated Engineering Laboratories of Oakland will do additional materials testing and construction inspection for the Girls' Softball Field Project at Emerson. The added amount includes a $5,835.19 contingency and raises the agreement's maximum from $30,000 to $94,187.07. All other terms stay the same.

enrichment.headline: Adds $9,417.05 and 120 days to One Workplace's furniture contract for the Glenview project
enrichment.summary: One Workplace of San Leandro is delivering and selling new furniture for the Glenview New Construction Project. This amendment raises the agreement's maximum from $607,405.23 to $616,822.28 and extends it by 120 calendar days, from December 31, 2020 to April 30, 2021. All other terms stay the same.
